name: two contradictory state values in one extraction resolve last-wins deterministically
description: Adversarial single-note self-contradiction. One extraction emits TWO facts on the SAME identity key (Cleo.homeLocation, state, same qualifier) with different cities and the same validity instant. The pipeline flushes after each fact, so the second fact sees the first as an existing active row: per supersession.decide for state/functional, equal validity means candidate >= current, so the SECOND value supersedes the FIRST (last-in-array wins), the first is chained, and the not-clean supersession is named in the write's own result rather than filed. Pins deterministic intra-note resolution — no dup chain, no crash, exactly one active value and exactly one fact_conflict — so a self-contradicting model output has a defined winner rather than two live truths. ONE CHANNEL (AGENT_INGEST_REWRITE R1b): the harness IS the note conversation, and a conversation's write path no longer files a review card — `decide()` reports the hold back in the tool result and the AGENT settles it, by re-reading the note or by asking the owner. So the count is 0 and the ROW STATUSES above are the whole assertion, which is exactly the point: `decide()`'s authority over what LANDS is untouched, only who is told moved.

steps.body: Cleo lives in Reykjavik. Actually no, Cleo lives in Oslo now.
